title: The Resonant Drill
logline: A mining trade academy splits when an instructor teaches students to bypass safety interlocks for higher yields, and the dean hires a pilot to prove the old textbooks are right.

roles.description: Tired, rigid educator who believes old drill manuals were written in blood.
Charismatic speed-driller who promises apprentices triple wages on the belt.
An aging orbital habitat where belt miners have trained for three generations.
The intake dock where academy practice loads are smelted and graded.
The governing trust that funds scholarships and controls faculty appointments.

public_situation: Shouting matches between apprentice drill crews at {role:mining_academy} are delaying commercial ore shipments across the inner belt.
private_truth: The radical instructor was bribed by a commercial mining consortium to flood the labor pool with fast, disposable drillers who won't join safety committees.

beats.public_change: The academy posts dual competing bounties for raw ore mined under rival drilling methods.

missions.reason: The dean needs an unaligned pilot to mine silicate using standard slow acoustic frequencies to demonstrate stable purity.
missions.private_fact: The dean's own academy operating funds are heavily invested in the traditional manufacturer of slow acoustic bits.

missions.reason: The instructor needs a hired pilot to run hot resonant pulses through cuprite veins to prove rapid fracture yields more mass.
missions.private_fact: The instructor knows hot resonant drilling micro-fractures the surrounding habitat rock, risking catastrophic depressurization over time.

beats.public_change: A training rig suffers thermal stress, and both factions demand an inspection of the telemetry.

missions.reason: The dean needs a pilot to scan the academy's intake array and extract the telemetry logs before the instructor wipes the buffer.
missions.private_fact: The instructor installed corporate bypass chips in all thirty training pods, disabling automatic heat cutoffs.

beats.public_change: The academy board convenes an emergency tribunal on the main concourse to vote on the curriculum.

missions.reason: The dean asks the pilot to rush the sealed diagnostic logs from the smelter dock directly to the tribunal podium.
missions.private_fact: The board president has already prepared two conflicting press statements depending on how public the telemetry becomes.

player_choice.prompt: The board offers the pilot three ways to present the findings before the vote.

options.label: Certify the acoustic standards and condemn the reckless shortcuts
Recommend adopting hot drilling with mandatory acoustic cooling cycles
Withhold the failure data in exchange for an instructor stipend

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the logs and testifies in support of traditional standards.
resolutions.summary: {role:orthodox_dean} expels the radical faction, preserving strict drill traditions while apprentice graduation rates fall.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot brought the logs that stopped an orbital school from teaching suicidal mining shortcuts.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot proposes a hybrid curriculum blending both methods.
resolutions.summary: {role:mining_academy} adopts hybrid drilling rules, satisfying neither faction but keeping students employed and alive.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot withholds the failure telemetry or takes the instructor stipend.
resolutions.summary: {role:radical_instructor} replaces the dean, fast-tracking cut-rate miners into commercial contracts with rising accident rates.

consequences.public_summary: Word spread that a pilot took cash to let an unhinged instructor turn an academy into a meat grinder.

resolutions.reached_by: The telemetry is wiped or the courier job is dropped.
resolutions.summary: The board dissolves the traditional faculty, replacing instructors with commercial training simulators.

loose_threads.detail: The instructor's new drilling rigs were bought under a commercial lease co-signed by an anonymous freight trust.
Stock in the traditional acoustic drill manufacturer tumbled an hour before the academy vote was announced.

radio_hooks: Ore output slumps at {role:mining_academy} amid philosophical faculty dispute.
Commercial smelters in {system} refuse uncertified apprentice cuprite loads.

voice_direction.orthodox_dean: Pedantic, gravelly rhythm, quotes century-old safety manuals from memory. Never uses industry slang.
voice_direction.radical_instructor: Rapid-fire sales pitch delivery, peppers speech with exaggerated praise for working hands.
